title: VerbsPvP mods
description: VerbsPvP Mods is a performance and visual clarity Minecraft PvP modpack focused on FPS, smooth gameplay, and quality-of-life improvements.
body:
**VerbsPvP**

VerbsPvP is a Minecraft Fabric modpack focused on performance, visual clarity, and quality-of-life improvements. It is designed to provide a smooth and stable gameplay experience for PvP practice, survival, and multiplayer servers without altering core combat mechanics.

The goal of this pack is to improve FPS, reduce visual clutter, and make gameplay more responsive and readable while keeping everything fair and vanilla-compatible.

---

## Features:

* Performance improvements for higher and more stable FPS
* Visual clarity enhancements for cleaner gameplay visibility
* Quality-of-life mods for smoother gameplay experience
* Lightweight Fabric-based setup for fast loading and stability

---

## Important:

* This modpack does NOT include hacked clients or automation
* No aim assist, auto-combat, or unfair gameplay advantages
* All mods are client-side performance or utility focused only
